decisions.reason: Because the fifteen-day express delivery program remained on the website through 2024, it appears to be performing at least near aspiration levels, though its relatively modest prominence makes it somewhat more droppable if management reallocates slack.

The seventy-two-hour express delivery program was still offered in 2024, but as a demanding service innovation with potentially higher coordination costs, it is more vulnerable if results fall short of aspiration despite the firm's ability to tolerate some uncertainty.

Its own dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests the express delivery program for doors and gates has strategic importance and has likely met internal aspirations sufficiently to justify continued support.

The online ordering and digital services platform has remained prominently presented, and for a large German metal products firm it likely supports the core business broadly enough that management would keep it unless performance clearly disappointed.

The fire and smoke protection door gained visibility from a website mention to its own page, which signals results above aspiration or rising strategic confidence, making withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
